analysis.reasonEn: Attempting to rebound after the prior two days of decline. RSI has exited oversold territory but has not yet stabilized above 50. MACD histogram shows improvement but remains weak in negative territory. The rebound lacks conviction with volume at 0.29x the 5-day average, indicating low reliability. Weekly ADX at 17.5 signals a non-trending phase with potential for short-term volatility. Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
